parameters.description_en: The node ID in the workflow draft.

parameters.description_en: The name of the input port of the experiment node. If this parameter is left empty, the merged schema of the entire node is returned.

parameters.description_en: The index of the variable port extension, starting from 0. This parameter is used when the port is a variable port.
